messages.author: e8bdfd51f8bc5695
messages.subject: Displaying Plot in Shiny
parts:
I am doing a naive Bayes classification in shiny. The plot function has multiple graphs where I can move to next graph by pressing enter key in console.
look at the code below
library(e1071)
library(caTools)
require(klaR)
library(MASS)

state<-read.table("haberman.data",sep=",")
colnames(state) <- c("patientAge.V1", "operationYear.V2","posiAxillary.V3","survivalStatus.V4")
state
str(state)
state$survivalStatus.V4=as.factor(state$survivalStatus.V4)
levels(state$survivalStatus.V4)[levels(state$survivalStatus.V4)=="1"] <- "Survived5Years"
levels(state$survivalStatus.V4)[levels(state$survivalStatus.V4)=="2"] <- "notSurvived5Years"
set.seed(500)
summary(state)

x=state[,-4]
y=state$survivalStatus.V4

model=train(x,y,'nb',trControl=trainControl(method='cv',number = 10))
model

p<-predict(model,x)
confusionMatrix(p,y)
n<-NaiveBayes(state$survivalStatus.V4~.,data=state)
png("aa.png")
plot(n)
dev.off()



How can I pass an enter key through shiny?
Or how can i Save these multiple graphs as image files separately
